name: Mordecai
overview: Mordecai was a Jewish captive living in the Persian palace of Shushan, descended from the Benjamite lineage and taken into exile during the Babylonian captivity (Esther 2:5-6). He played a crucial role as the foster father of Esther, whom he raised as his own daughter after she was orphaned (Esther 2:7). Mordecai's faithfulness and vigilance are highlighted when he uncovers a plot against King Ahasuerus, which he reports through Esther, leading to the conspirators' punishment and his own recognition (Esther 2:21-23). This sets the stage for his later promotion and intercession on behalf of the Jewish people, underscoring God's providential care through Mordecai's obedience.
